degraded.effect: Monthly averages from the ECB instead of daily Banque de France yields: a daily move, a stop or a target inside the month is invisible, and the latest value is up to five weeks old. New book trades switch to the daily series automatically once Webstat succeeds; open trades keep the series they were filled on. A trade requested on a monthly series fills at the next month's average, dated the 1st, once the ECB publishes it after that month ends. No free daily French 10-year source works from GitHub Actions (checked 30 Oct 2026): the ECB's public market-data set has no country bond yields, Eurostat's daily series (irt_lt_mcby_d) is no longer published, the Bundesbank's yields by ISIN cover German securities only, FRED has only the OECD monthly figure, and AFT, CNBC and Stooq refuse automated requests.

degraded.effect: Monthly averages from the ECB instead of daily Banque de France yields: a daily move, a stop or a target inside the month is invisible, and the latest value is up to five weeks old. New book trades switch to the daily series automatically once Webstat succeeds; open trades keep the series they were filled on. A trade requested on a monthly series fills at the next month's average, dated the 1st, once the ECB publishes it after that month ends. No free daily French 10-year source works from GitHub Actions (checked 30 Oct 2026): the ECB's public market-data set has no country bond yields, Eurostat's daily series (irt_lt_mcby_d) is no longer published, the Bundesbank's yields by ISIN cover German securities only, FRED has only the OECD monthly figure, and AFT, CNBC and Stooq refuse automated requests.
